title: Stopped working about fifth use
text: Stopped working about fifth use. Was working great, I love it. But the middle of using it the last time it turned off and wouldn’t turn back on. Going to buy a different brand now, guess this is what I get for buying the cheap one. It never cleaned super deeply or fast, had to make multiple pass overs of the carpet before it even pulled up some dirt or even got close to being dry.  When it broke my carpet was still very damp/wet so I had to pull out lots of fans to dry it. Hoping I don’t get mold or anything.

product_metadata.title: Hoover PowerDash Pet+ Compact Carpet Cleaner, Lightweight, FH50751, White

description: The new & improved Hoover PowerDash Pet is a powerful, compact carpet washer designed for convenient and effortless cleaning anywhere in your home. Our Heatforce Technology also assists with dry time so you can get back on your carpets faster.
